subject: Game Theory
title: When Cooperation Wins
description: A micro-lesson that makes When Cooperation Wins usable.

hook.text: The dilemma seems bleak, but cooperation thrives everywhere—from bacteria to global trade.

buildup.text: Evolution shows cooperators can outcompete defectors when they cluster together.

discovery.text: Repeated interaction, reputation, punishment, and shared identity all tilt toward cooperation.

twist.text: Even in one-shot games, humans cooperate more than theory predicts. We're wired for fairness.

climax.text: The dilemma isn't a death sentence for cooperation. It's a design challenge for better systems.

punchline.text: Cooperation is hard but not hopeless.

quiz.question: What determines whether cooperation wins?
options: The design of rules and institutions
